$comment: The SOW-adjacent event: someone edited the project description. This is authored intent, so the event may only ever produce a desk item — never a Linear write, and never a worker pass that edits the description.

project.name: Permissions overhaul
project.description: Scope: project membership gates every read path. Out of scope: org-wide roles.

policy.wakes: one reconcile pass that compares the new description against the branch, then a desk item quoting the diff
policy.refusal: SowEdit at exit 1 if anything tries to write the description back
